subject.title: fix embedded compaction hook reset API

question: Should `resetSession(reason?)` become a public capability only for `after_compaction`, or should every embedded agent hook receive it?
rationale: This adds a compatibility-sensitive plugin contract, and the permanent scope cannot be inferred safely from the Remnic use case or implementation alone.

options.title: After-compaction only
options.body: Expose the API only to all direct, context-engine, and native after-compaction emitters, with the outer lifecycle owning the final drain.

options.title: All embedded hooks
options.body: Approve the broader contract, document which hooks receive it, and prove safe reset ordering for every hook lifecycle that can call it.

options.title: Pause the API
options.body: Keep session reset internal until maintainers sponsor a stable plugin contract and lifecycle ownership model.

recommendation.title: After-compaction only
recommendation.body: Expose the API only to all direct, context-engine, and native after-compaction emitters, with the outer lifecycle owning the final drain.

likelyOwner.reason: Their adjacent compaction-runtime history makes them the strongest available routing candidate for the API-scope decision.
